facts.fact: IMA formally started the USD 150 million, 12-month Public Digital Infrastructure Project with the implementation contract with TIS Angola on 31 July 2026, aiming to strengthen interoperability of public systems, digital identity and e-service security.

systems.system: Projecto de Aceleração Digital de Angola (PADA)

facts.fact: IMA and TIS Tech Angola signed the contract on 17 June 2026 for the USD 150 million Public Digital Infrastructure Project, which is to create the technological backbone enabling interoperability among the country's ministries and public services.

On 2026-06-17 the IMA and TIS Tech Angola signed a 12-month, USD 150 million contract for the Digitais Publicas project, whose critical computing component will support the public-sector interoperability platform so systems of different public services can exchange data.

facts.fact: Despacho Presidencial 344/26 of 27 August 2026 authorised USD 13m for public administration interoperability, to create a secure channel for exchanging data between public and private systems, per Valor Económico.

note: An interoperability platform is mentioned only as an attempt in a minister's speech.
X-Road was demonstrated and a National Interoperability Platform is a next step; no platform procured, built or piloted is stated.

facts.fact: The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025) that a government service bus platform, API.GOV.AO on WSO2, is in use, dated 2021.
